blocks.text: Psalms 56 contains 13 verses. It opens with: Be merciful unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: All the day long he fighting oppresseth me. It concludes with: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: `Hast thou' not `delivered' my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living? Psalm 57 For the Chief Musician; `set to' Al-tash-heth. `A Psalm' of David. Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
